import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def f(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 2))

def pct(x):
    return float(np.round(x, 1))

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# ---- Totals ----
tot_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
tot_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"TW","value":f(tot_rev_tw),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LW","value":f(tot_rev_lw),
              "formula":"sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if not pd.isna(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"LY","value":f(tot_rev_ly),
                  "formula":"sum(Revenue_LY)"})

if tot_rev_lw and tot_rev_lw != 0:
    wow_total = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_lw) / tot_rev_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

if tot_rev_ly and not pd.isna(tot_rev_ly) and tot_rev_ly != 0:
    yoy_total = (tot_rev_tw - tot_rev_ly) / tot_rev_ly * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"revenue","period":"YoY","value":pct(yoy_total),
                  "formula":"(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"TW","value":f(tot_units_tw),
              "formula":"sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"LW","value":f(tot_units_lw),
              "formula":"sum(Units_LW)"})
if tot_units_lw and tot_units_lw != 0:
    wow_units = (tot_units_tw - tot_units_lw) / tot_units_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"units","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow_units),
                  "formula":"(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100"})

facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"TW","value":f(tot_orders_tw),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"LW","value":f(tot_orders_lw),
              "formula":"sum(Orders_LW)"})
if tot_orders_lw and tot_orders_lw != 0:
    wow_orders = (tot_orders_tw - tot_orders_lw) / tot_orders_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity":"TOTAL","metric":"orders","period":"WoW","value":pct(wow_orders),
                  "formula":"(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100"})

# ---- Top entities by revenue this week ----
top5 = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, row in top5.iterrows():
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Rank')):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"rank", "period":"TW",
                      "value": f(row['Rank']), "formula":"Rank column (ranked by Revenue_TW desc)"})
    if not pd.isna(row.get('Share_Pct')):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"share", "period":"TW",
                      "value": pct(row['Share_Pct']), "formula":"Share_Pct column (Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100)"})

# ---- Biggest WoW movers ----
wow_df = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct']).sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False)
top_wow_gainers = wow_df.head(3)
top_wow_losers = wow_df.tail(3)

for _, row in top_wow_gainers.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"WoW",
                  "value": pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

for _, row in top_wow_losers.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"WoW",
                  "value": pct(row['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

# ---- Biggest YoY movers ----
yoy_df = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct']).sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False)
if not yoy_df.empty:
    top_yoy_gainer = yoy_df.head(1)
    top_yoy_loser = yoy_df.tail(1)
    for _, row in top_yoy_gainer.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"YoY",
                      "value": pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})
    for _, row in top_yoy_loser.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric":"revenue", "period":"YoY",
                      "value": pct(row['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula":"(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

# Trim to 25 facts max
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
